cunīculus, cunīculī m.

noun, second declension

tunnel, underground passage

An ancient noun applied to sand play.

Examples

  • ventus ē specū ērūpit, lūmina appāruērunt

    a wind burst out of the tunnel, lights appearedLibellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

Other words

  • specus, specūs m. — tunnel; cave

    noun, fourth declension · classical · Traupman 219, 203

    Traupman prints only specus.

See also hole, sandcastle, metro, Animals.
